implementation: Independent bounded C implementation of documented upstream page/footer/fsindex grammar; no installer input is executed.

primary_sources.purpose: Original CFS0002 page tables, MD5/CRC encoding and CFS2.200 recursive index serialization. No upstream Tcl source is compiled or distributed.

supported: Raw, raw Deflate, bzip2 with four-byte CookFS wrapper and LZMA-Alone pages/indexes
MD5 and CookFS CRC32/length page integrity
Recursive folders, UTF-8 filenames, empty files and page-slice file assembly
___bitrockBigFileN reconstruction, retaining orphan chunks rather than discarding payload
Opaque PE/ELF/shell prefixes, dist-endoffset markers, bounded signed/launcher tails and cookfsinfo.txt redirect
limitations: Encrypted/proprietary maui::util or custom codecs are rejected; no encrypted payload/password recovery is claimed.
Installer actions, links and executable rebuilding are not interpreted; actual indexed archive contents are returned.
No installer execution or host temporary writes. TEST decodes, checksums and validates all referenced page slices in RAM.
Fast auto-detection requires an EOF CFS0002 marker, a prefix dist-endoffset marker or a marker in the last 128 KiB; explicit reader validation searches the last 16 MiB.
RAM budget includes cached decoded pages and native decoder workspace estimates; archives larger than the configured budget fail explicitly.

validation.reference: Unmodified MIT Python upstream parser plus independent standard-library zlib/bz2/lzma producers.
validation.freestanding_O2_undefined_symbols: xx_* API and expected __chkstk only, no CRT imports
